stem:
The diagram shows figure $F$ drawn for Karan's geometry class.

Which claim correctly classifies figure $F$?

options.text: Figure $F$ is a quadrilateral because it has four straight sides.
Figure $F$ is not a quadrilateral because two sides have different lengths.
Figure $F$ is a triangle because one corner looks sharper than the others.
Figure $F$ is a circle because the longest side bends the eye along a curve.

teacher.key_rationale: F has four straight sides, so it is a quadrilateral. Unequal side lengths, a sharp corner, or a curved impression do not change that classification.
teacher.figure_note: Added an irregular four-sided straight polygon labeled F.
